requirements.title: Post-transfer error conditions make file position indeterminate
requirements.definition: If an error condition occurs during data transfer, the position of the file is indeterminate.

pending.posttransfer-error-position-indeterminat: No portable oracle exists for the exact position after an error condition; future error tests must first reposition or use only status observations before any data-position assertion.

requirements.title: Reading an endfile record positions after the endfile record absent error
requirements.definition: If no error occurs but an end-of-file condition occurs as a result of reading an endfile record, the file is positioned after the endfile record.

pending.read-endfile-record-positions-after-endf: Create records followed by an endfile record, read until the end-of-file condition with IOSTAT checked only for the named/portable end status, then use registered BACKSPACE/REWIND behavior to observe the after-endfile relation without inspecting marker bytes.

requirements.title: Unformatted stream transfer does not change position absent error and output can extend terminal point
requirements.definition: For unformatted stream input/output with no error, the file position is not changed; for unformatted stream output, a file position beyond the previous terminal point sets the terminal point to that file position.

pending.unformatted-stream-position-unchanged-af: Use explicit POS= unformatted stream transfer, then INQUIRE(POS=) or a second POS-sensitive operation under registered rules to show the current position remains the established value.
pending.unformatted-stream-output-extends-termin: Open a known short unformatted stream file, write with POS= beyond the previous terminal point, then use registered size/position or readback of the written value to observe extension without asserting gap contents.

requirements.title: Formatted stream input at end-of-file does not change position absent error
requirements.definition: For formatted stream input, if an end-of-file condition occurs, the file position is not changed.

pending.formatted-stream-eof-position-unchanged: After establishing a formatted stream position with INQUIRE(POS=), attempt input that reaches EOF with IOSTAT observing only the portable end condition, then inquire/read from the saved position to show it was unchanged.

requirements.title: Nonadvancing transfer post-positioning depends on EOR, EOF, and error conditions
requirements.definition: For nonadvancing input, an end-of-record condition without error or end-of-file positions after the record just read; absent error, end-of-file, and end-of-record, nonadvancing input leaves position unchanged; absent error, nonadvancing output leaves position unchanged.

pending.nonadvancing-input-eor-positions-after-r: Read a distinctive record nonadvancing until EOR with IOSTAT observing only portable EOR status, then perform the next read into sentinels and expect the following record.
pending.nonadvancing-input-no-condition-position: Read a prefix of a distinctive record without EOR/EOF/error, then continue reading into nonblank sentinels and expect the remaining characters from the same record.
pending.nonadvancing-output-no-error-position-un: Write a prefix nonadvancing, then write a suffix without repositioning and read back the combined record; distinctive sentinels show no record advance occurred.

requirements.title: All other data transfer cases position after the record and make it preceding
requirements.definition: In all other cases after data transfer, the file is positioned after the record just read or written and that record becomes the preceding record.

pending.other-transfer-positions-after-record: Use an advancing sequential transfer on a record with distinctive successor, then read/backspace under registered rules to observe that the position is after the transferred record.
pending.other-transfer-record-becomes-preceding: After the transfer, execute a registered BACKSPACE/read sequence into sentinels and expect the transferred record as the preceding record.

requirements.title: Formatted stream output sets terminal point after highest transferred position absent error
requirements.definition: For a formatted stream output statement with no error, the terminal point is set to the next position after the highest-numbered position to which a datum was transferred by the statement.

pending.formatted-stream-output-terminal-after-h: Write distinctive formatted stream data, including a case with explicit positioning edit descriptors only after clause 13 registration, then use INQUIRE(POS=)/readback to observe data up to the highest transferred position without asserting marker bytes.
